<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>כדי ללבוש ק׳ ושריון וכ׳</he> strong enough to wear helmet, mail and (carry) arms.—Pl. <he>קַסִּידִין</he>. Y’lamd. to Gen. III, 22, quot. in Ar. (ref. to <he>כרבלתהון</he>) <he>אלו הק׳</he> that means the helmets.
